name: Ca_HVA m-gate data-budget-capacity diagnosis
prior_evidence: Task 1 valid NO-GO at registered one-step threshold; physical-tau stable and still improving at 10000 steps

diagnostic_contrasts.factorial_comparison_policy: density, capacity and objective contrasts use every arm at the same fixed 10000-step checkpoint; extended checkpoints are used only for the budget contrast and final candidate selection
diagnostic_contrasts.data_limited: dense improves matched base development RMSE by at least 20%
diagnostic_contrasts.capacity_limited: width 32 improves matched width 16 development RMSE by at least 20%
diagnostic_contrasts.objective_or_identifiability_limited: auxiliary-rate objective improves matched endpoint-only development RMSE by at least 20%
diagnostic_contrasts.budget_limited: 50000-step checkpoint improves its own 10000-step development RMSE by at least 20% and the curve has not reversed

fresh_confirmation.voltage_grid: disjoint half-step in-support points plus new OOD points

engineering_continuation_gate.meaning: Task 2 may start while Task 1 accuracy remains an explicit unresolved refinement debt

forbidden_interpretations: The old Task 1 sealed set may not select Task 1b variants.
Auxiliary teacher rates may not become deployment inputs.
Engineering continuation may not be reported as passing the scientific 1e-3 gate.
Held-voltage evidence may not be generalized to coupled voltage paths.
